why: FORMATTING CHECKED BY THE LINTER, with no dedicated formatter in the repository. `@stylistic/eslint-plugin` is where eslint's layout rules went when core dropped them, so `eslint .` here comes back non-zero on a badly formatted file — the practice the rule wants, by a fourth road. A rule that demanded prettier, biome or dprint by name would accuse this repository of having no formatter while it fails the build on formatting, which is the exact error the `@radix-ui` rule made against the only one of six repositories that had got it right. The `fail` side is the same repository with `eslint . --fix`: the plugin is still declared, but `--fix` rewrites the layout and comes back green, so nothing gates — the eslint spelling of `prettier --write`. It also locks the guard against the cheap version of this branch: accepting any `eslint` invocation would pass `assay`, which has eslint and eslint-config-next and no formatting rule turned on at all.

commits.mensagem: eslint com regras de estilo, sem --fix
